title: 第23章 实验班第24章 刮痧疗法
content_zh:
“这位同学，干嘛呢？想说话啊。来来来，我让给你来说一天！”李胜祖看到了高山和唐吉德窃窃私语的样子，立刻就训斥起来。
这让高山和唐吉德立刻正经起来，李胜祖这才继续道：“不瞒诸位！我说句实话。在我看来，这所谓的实验班完全没有必要！中医不是这么学的。古时候学医，三年识药、两年学经、一年跑堂，再到随师临诊、观摩医案。没有个十年八年是学不会的。即便到了这一步，还得经过师父认可才能真正坐堂。这才是真正的中医传承。”
说到这，李胜祖停顿了一下，脸上写满了鄙视：“就你们，中不中、西不西的，学了这么三四年，甚至还有半路出家的人。我不知道院长是怎么想的。但是，在我看来，这完全是浪费时间。这是我们研究院第一届中医实验班。院长给你们争取到了可以颁发博士文凭的机会。可是，我告诉你们，你们要做好永远都出不了师的准备。”
李胜祖一开口就是一番鄙夷。其实这就是下马威了。但是李胜祖说的也有他的道理。事实上这就是当代医学教育界的一种争论——中医的传承，到底是传统师承好，还是大学教育好。现在看来，程焕真大师已经在做这个方面的尝试了。
唐吉德突然看着高山，偷偷竖起大拇指，压低着喉咙：“兄弟，你厉害啊。竟然是半路出家的人，难怪没见过你了，你是哪所学校的啊？”
高山目不斜视，低声道：“南雅！”
“这位同学，要不我让你来讲。我坐着听如何？”李胜祖盯着唐吉德，缓缓说着。
随着李胜祖的话语娓娓而来，高山心中倒也是明白了。程焕真并不仅仅只招收了自己。看样子，有没有自己这个实验班都会进行下去。
从李胜祖的话语来看。这个小实验班应该是采用师徒传承的那种模式教学。根本就没有具体的毕业期限。看似有一个博士的头衔在前面招手。可谁能保证自己能通过考核啊。
虽然不要学费。可大家都是成年人了，饮食男女，衣食住行那都是要钱的。坚持不下去也是正常的。高山扪心自问了一下，如果自己没有医门的传承。完全是硬拼硬的在这个实验班的话。高山相信自己一年都坚持不了。
看到唐吉德不再说话，李胜祖倒也没有紧追不放了，继续道：“你们很幸运，这是院长和周元道大师联合拟定的。分两个实验班，一个在我们这里，另外一个在周元道大师那边。一共十个人。我们将采取传统中医师徒传承的方式进行教学。也就是说，在未来，你们不仅仅是坐在教室里学习，有可能你们在山上采药，有可能在药房炮制中药材。更有可能在临床跟着学习。你们将会集中中医所有的资源。如果你们能够在中医药材、药理、炮制、在方剂、经义、针灸、按摩、正骨等等方面得到两位大师的认可，你们就可以毕业，在坐的如果哪位天赋异禀有可能一年你就拿到了博士文凭。当然！”
李胜祖话锋一转，环顾众人，面无表情道：“更有可能你们十年都还在这里，如果你们这里有人能坚持十年的话！想发财的别来这里，想出名的，更别来这里，中医大师不是谁都能当的，更多的人能够跟我一样。就算是很厉害了。所以，我给你们时间考虑，你们随时都可以提出退学。”
全新的教学理念，师承古风的教学方式。这不是培养中医人才，这是要培养中医全才啊。看着这架势，程老和周老所图很大啊。随着屠教授依靠着中医药的理论和研究，借助着现代的技术获得了诺贝尔医学奖之后。全球的中医药产业都在蓬勃的发展。
看似这写产业的发展对中医是巨大的促进，可只有真正的中医大师才明白，这一切都是表象，因为研究的都是中药。假以时日，真正的中医就会走向灭亡。很显然，这两位大师坐不住了。
李胜祖很是满意自己的这一番训诫，态度不正，怎么能学好中医呢。唯有心怀敬畏，才能认真学习。这是他的不二法门。
接下来，李胜祖弯腰从会议桌之下拿出了一个笼子，笼子里一只漂亮的小白兔很是悠闲。李胜祖再拿出了一个药箱，取出了一个精致的长方形小盒子，里面放着几块精致的水牛角刮痧板。紧接着又拿出来了数个直径只有两三厘米，高度只有五六厘米的竹制拔罐。
李胜祖开口道：“都认识吧。刮痧板和拔罐。不要觉得按摩、刮痧、拔罐这些都是足浴店、按摩店才有的。事实上。按摩在中医的历史上已经有了数千年的历史。从中医出现开始，按摩就已经存在了。今天，我要跟你们讲的第一课，就是刮痧和拔罐！”
“李老师，这多不好啊。我们这个五个人，单了一个啊。再说，女生也在，是不是……”唐吉德开口问了起来。配合着这小子那略显猥琐的笑容，顿时就让两个女生投来了鄙夷的目光。
李胜祖冷哼一声，道：“唐吉德同学，你想多了。中医无小事，别觉得刮痧和拔罐简单。操作不当的话，没有疗效不说，严重的照样可以致人死亡。所以，你们的手法训练对象是它。”
说到这，李胜祖指了指笼子里面的兔子。紧接着，李胜祖接二连三，直接从桌子下拿出了六个装着兔子的笼子。然后看着众人，道：“接下来，谁上来操作一下，让我看看你们的基本功！”

这一幕，顿时就让原本严肃认真的众人一下闹哄哄起来了。
穿着红色卫衣的女生更是低声跟同伴道：“小慧，动物怎么刮痧拔罐啊。都这么多毛。而且，动物又没有穴位和经络。”
高山此刻却是站了起来：“同学，万物有灵，这个世界大部分的动物其实都是有穴位和经络的。中医包罗万象，只不过随着时间的推移，很多中医典籍的消失和技术的失传，再加上我们学习的中医仅仅只是针对人类，所以我们误认为只有人类有经络和穴位罢了。”
content_en:
"What are you doing, classmate? You want to talk. Come on, come on, I'll let you talk for a day!" Li Shengzu saw Gao Shan and Tang Jide whispering and immediately scolded him.
This made Gao Shan and Tang Jide become serious immediately, and Li Shengzu continued: "I'll tell you the truth! In my opinion, this so-called experimental class is completely unnecessary! This is not how Chinese medicine is learned. In ancient times, it took three years to learn medicine, two years to study classics, and one year to attend the clinic, and then follow the teacher for clinical diagnosis and observation of medical cases. There is no one who cannot learn in ten or eight years. Even at this stage, you have to be approved by the master before you can actually sit in the classroom. This is the true inheritance of traditional Chinese medicine."
Speaking of this, Li Shengzu paused for a moment, with contempt written on his face: "Just you, those of you who are neither good nor good, have been studying for three or four years, and some have even become a monk halfway. I don't know what the dean thinks. But, in my opinion, this is a complete waste of time. This is the first experimental class of traditional Chinese medicine in our institute. The dean has given you the opportunity to issue a doctoral diploma. However, I tell you, you must be prepared to never become a monk."
Li Shengzu was full of contempt as soon as he opened his mouth. In fact, this is a show of authority. But what Li Shengzu said also made sense. In fact, this is a debate in the contemporary medical education community - whether it is better to inherit traditional Chinese medicine from teachers or university education. Now it seems that Master Cheng Huanzhen is already making attempts in this area.
Tang Jide suddenly looked at Gao Shan, secretly gave a thumbs up, and lowered his voice: "Brother, you are amazing. You are a monk halfway. No wonder I haven't seen you before. Which school are you from?"
Gao Shan didn't look sideways and whispered: "Nanya!"
"Classmate, how about I let you speak? How about I sit and listen?" Li Shengzu stared at Tang Jide and said slowly.
Following Li Shengzu's words, Gao Shan understood in his heart. Cheng Huanzhen didn't just recruit himself. It seems that this experimental class will continue with or without me.
Judging from Li Shengzu’s words. This small experimental class should be taught using the model passed down from master to apprentice. There is no specific deadline for graduation at all. There seems to be a doctorate title waving in front. But who can guarantee that he can pass the assessment?
No tuition fee though. But we are all adults, and food, clothing, housing and transportation all cost money. It’s normal not to be able to hold on. Gao Shan asked himself, what if he didn't have the inheritance of medicine? If you are in this experimental class, you will have to fight hard. Gao Shan believed that he could not persist for a year.
Seeing that Tang Jide stopped talking, Li Shengzu did not pursue him and continued: "You are very lucky. This was jointly drawn up by the dean and Master Zhou Yuandao. There are two experimental classes, one with us and the other with Master Zhou Yuandao. There are ten people in total. We will teach in the traditional Chinese medicine apprenticeship method. In other words, in the future, you will not only sit in the classroom and learn, but also possibly You collect medicines in the mountains and prepare Chinese medicinal materials in the pharmacy. You are more likely to learn in the clinic. You will pool all the resources of Chinese medicine. If you can get the approval of two masters in Chinese medicine materials, pharmacology, acupuncture, massage, bone setting, etc., you can graduate. If you are talented, you may get a doctorate in one year. "
Li Shengzu changed the topic, looked around the crowd, and said with an expressionless face: "It is more likely that you will still be here for ten years, if any of you can persist for ten years! Don't come here if you want to get rich, let alone if you want to be famous. Not everyone can be a master of Chinese medicine, and more people can be like me. Even if they are very good. So, I will give you time to think about it, and you can drop out of school at any time."
Brand new teachingConcept, learning from ancient teaching methods. This is not about cultivating TCM talents, it is about cultivating all-round TCM talents. Looking at this posture, Mr. Cheng and Mr. Zhou have big plans. After Professor Tu relied on the theory and research of traditional Chinese medicine and modern technology to win the Nobel Prize in Medicine. The global traditional Chinese medicine industry is booming.
It seems that the development of this industry has greatly promoted traditional Chinese medicine, but only true masters of traditional Chinese medicine understand that all these are appearances, because they are all studying traditional Chinese medicine. In time, true Chinese medicine will become extinct. Obviously, these two masters could not sit still.
Li Shengzu was very satisfied with his admonishment. How could he learn Chinese medicine well if his attitude was not right? Only with awe can we study seriously. This is his only method.
Next, Li Shengzu bent down and took out a cage from under the conference table. In the cage, a beautiful little white rabbit was very leisurely. Li Shengzu took out another medicine box and took out a small, exquisite rectangular box, which contained several exquisite buffalo horn scraping boards. Then he took out several bamboo cupping cups with a diameter of only two or three centimeters and a height of only five or six centimeters.
Li Shengzu said: "We all know it. Gua Sha board and cupping. Don't think that massage, scraping, and cupping are only available in foot spas and massage parlors. In fact, massage has been in the history of traditional Chinese medicine for thousands of years. Massage has been around since the emergence of traditional Chinese medicine. Today, the first lesson I want to teach you is scraping and cupping!"
"Teacher Li, how bad is this? There are five of us, and one of us is alone. Besides, the girl is also there, is it..." Tang Jide started to ask. Coupled with this boy's slightly obscene smile, the two girls immediately cast disdainful glances at him.
Li Shengzu snorted coldly and said: "Classmate Tang Jide, you are overthinking. There is nothing trivial about traditional Chinese medicine. Don't think that scraping and cupping are simple. If done improperly, there will be no curative effect. In serious cases, it can still cause death. Therefore, it is the target of your technique training."
Speaking of this, Li Shengzu pointed to the rabbit in the cage. Immediately afterwards, Li Shengzu took out six cages containing rabbits directly from under the table. Then he looked at everyone and said: "Next, whoever comes up to do the operation, let me see your basic skills!"
This scene immediately caused the originally serious crowd to start making noises.
The girl in a red sweatshirt whispered to her companion: "Xiao Hui, how do animals do scraping and cupping? They are all so hairy. Moreover, animals have no acupuncture points and meridians."
Gao Shan stood up at this moment: "Classmate, all things are animistic. Most animals in this world actually have acupuncture points and meridians. Traditional Chinese medicine is all-encompassing, but as time goes by, many traditional Chinese medicine classics disappear and the technology is lost. In addition, the traditional Chinese medicine we learn is only for humans, so we mistakenly believe that only humans have meridians and acupuncture points."
